name: Pathet Lao
native: ປະເທດລາວ (Pathet Lao)

predecessors.name: French Indochina
predecessors.text: the border provinces of Phongsali and Xam Neua (Houaphan), conquered by the PAVN in April 1953 and left to the Pathet Lao to occupy

successors.name: Lao People's Democratic Republic
successors.text: the whole of Laos: the Lao People's Democratic Republic proclaimed on 2 December 1975 with Souphanouvong as President

ledger.x: 1953: the Pathet Lao takes the north-east.
1953: the Kingdom of Laos becomes independent (22 October) with the two provinces in rebel hands.
1957: a coalition government incorporating the Pathet Lao is established (November).
1961: a communist coalition drives 9,000 Royal Lao Army troops from the Plain of Jars (1 January).
1975: the Pathet Lao rules the whole country (2 December).
1975: the Plain of Jars passes to the new state.
1975: the Pathet Lao takes the state (23 August Vientiane; 2 December the monarchy abolished and the Lao People's Democratic Republic proclaimed with Souphanouvong as President).
1975: the movement becomes the state, the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

wars.name: Laotian Civil War
wars.outcome: Pathet Lao and North Vietnamese victory (infobox 23 May 1959 to 2 December 1975).

certainty.note: A guerrilla and regroupment zone without recorded lines; the Plain of Jars changed hands from 1961 to 1972.
